name: adm_3_2
character: The 3.2 programme as an ADM DirectSpeakers pack in a strict BW64 container: five channels (L, R, C, LFE1, LFE2) with their loudspeaker labels and positions as metadata. Same programme and level as immersive_3_2. Open-standard ADM, not a vendor master.
label: ADM BW64 3.2 loudspeaker bed
sources: ITU-R BS.2076 DirectSpeakers pack (typeLabel 0001) in a BW64 container (BS.2088); the pack and channel IDs are in the custom range (AP_00011001), not a common definition, because no common definition exists for this layout (from memory: custom IDs start at 1001 hex; verify against BS.2076)

Speaker labels M+030, M-030, M+000, LFE1, LFE2 follow the BS.2051 naming (from memory); LFE positions are nominal and the LFE channel formats carry a low-pass frequency element equal to the layout's stopband
Validation is this engine's structural reader (adm.validate_file); no third-party validator ran for this layout
